content_sections.heading: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector Eligibility Criteria 2026

rows.qualification_required: Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering OR Diploma in Automobile Engineering from State Board of Technical Education and Training, AP, or equivalent. Must hold a Motor Driving License with 3 years driving experience and Heavy Transport vehicles endorsement (2 years for women or if 3 years experience holders are unavailable; women holding LMV license must acquire Heavy Transport endorsement within 2 years of joining).
Degree in Mining Engineering from any recognised University in India or Diploma in Mining Engineering from Indian School of Mines, Dhanbad, or equivalent.
Bachelor's Degree in Science with Chemistry or B.Sc. (Pharmacy) of any University in India established or incorporated under Central, Provincial, or State Act or UGC recognised institution.
Geology degree qualification as specified in detailed notification.

B.Sc. Degree in Geology from any recognised University established by Central/State Act or UGC recognised institution (practical experience of not less than 1 year in mineral deposit investigation, geological mapping, mining, or underground water resources given preference).
B.Sc. Degree with Chemistry from University of India established or incorporated under Central, Provincial, or State Act or UGC recognised institution.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 106 provisional vacancies have been announced across various services, including 50 vacancies for Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: Online applications open on 06/11/2026 and close on 26/11/2026 at 11:59 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Degree in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering, or a Diploma in Automobile Engineering, along with a Motor Driving License, 3 years driving experience, and a Heavy Transport vehicle endorsement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector?
faq.answer: The age limit for Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector is 21 to 36 years as on 01/07/2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection comprises a single-level Written Examination in CBRT mode (no screening test) followed by a Computer Proficiency Test (CPT).
